nights.title: Alyssa Grace
nights.name: Alyssa Grace
nights.extract: Alyssa Grace Proffitt is an American singer-songwriter based in California. She made her recording debut in 2026 with "Dog with a Bone" and gained wider recognition through the singles "Picking Petals" and "Bloodstream".

en.who: Alyssa Grace Proffitt is an American singer-songwriter based in California. She gained wider recognition through the singles Picking Petals and Bloodstream.
facts: She made her recording debut in 2026 with Dog with a Bone.
Picking Petals and Bloodstream brought her wider recognition.

de.who: Alyssa Grace Proffitt ist eine amerikanische Singer-Songwriterin mit Wohnsitz in Kalifornien. Größere Bekanntheit erlangte sie durch die Singles Picking Petals und Bloodstream.
facts: Ihr Aufnahmedebüt gab sie 2026 mit Dog with a Bone.
Picking Petals und Bloodstream brachten ihr größere Bekanntheit.

tr.who: Alyssa Grace Proffitt, Kaliforniya merkezli Amerikalı bir şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. Picking Petals ve Bloodstream single'larıyla daha geniş bir kitleye ulaştı.
facts: Kayıt kariyerine 2026'da Dog with a Bone ile başladı.
Picking Petals ve Bloodstream ona daha geniş bir tanınırlık kazandırdı.

nights.title: Julia Jacklin - North America Tour 2026
nights.name: Julia Jacklin
nights.extract: Julia Jacklin is an Australian singer-songwriter from the Blue Mountains region of New South Wales. Jacklin's musical style has been described as indie pop, indie folk, and alternative country. She has released four studio albums, Don't Let the Kids Win (2016), Crushing (2019), Pre Pleasure (2022) and The Gem (2026). Jacklin has also performed with the band Phantastic Ferniture, with whom she released the debut single "Fuckin 'n' Rollin" and a self-titled album in 2018, followed by subsequent singles.

en.who: Julia Jacklin is an Australian singer-songwriter from the Blue Mountains region of New South Wales. Her musical style has been described as indie pop, indie folk and alternative country.
facts: She has released four studio albums, the latest being The Gem in 2026.
She has also performed with the band Phantastic Ferniture, with whom she released a self-titled album in 2018.

de.who: Julia Jacklin ist eine australische Singer-Songwriterin aus den Blue Mountains in New South Wales. Ihr Stil wurde als Indie-Pop, Indie-Folk und Alternative Country beschrieben.
facts: Sie hat vier Studioalben veröffentlicht, das letzte ist The Gem von 2026.
Sie trat außerdem mit der Band Phantastic Ferniture auf, mit der sie 2018 ein selbstbetiteltes Album veröffentlichte.

tr.who: Julia Jacklin, New South Wales'in Blue Mountains bölgesinden bir Avustralyalı şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. Müzik tarzı indie pop, indie folk ve alternatif country olarak tanımlanıyor.
facts: Dört stüdyo albümü çıkardı; sonuncusu 2026'da çıkan The Gem.
Phantastic Ferniture grubuyla da sahne aldı ve 2018'de grupla kendi adını taşıyan bir albüm yayımladı.

nights.title: Memphis LK
nights.name: Memphis LK
nights.extract: Memphis Lillian Fairfax Kelly, known professionally as Memphis LK, is an Australian singer, songwriter, record producer and DJ. She is the daughter of Australian actress Kaarin Fairfax and musician Paul Kelly. Memphis has played at festivals, Splendour in the Grass, Party in the Paddock, Beyond the Valley, Listen Out, Pitch Festival, Great Escape Festival and Way Out West. She is currently independent.

en.who: Memphis LK, real name Memphis Lillian Fairfax Kelly, is an Australian singer, songwriter, record producer and DJ. She is the daughter of actress Kaarin Fairfax and musician Paul Kelly.
facts: She has played at festivals such as Splendour in the Grass and Pitch Festival.
She has played at Beyond the Valley and Way Out West.

de.kicker: australische sängerin, songwriterin, produzentin und dj
de.who: Memphis LK, bürgerlich Memphis Lillian Fairfax Kelly, ist eine australische Sängerin, Songwriterin, Produzentin und DJ. Sie ist die Tochter der Schauspielerin Kaarin Fairfax und des Musikers Paul Kelly.
facts: Sie trat auf Festivals wie Splendour in the Grass und Pitch Festival auf.
Sie spielte unter anderem bei Beyond the Valley und Way Out West.

tr.kicker: avustralyalı şarkıcı, söz yazarı ve DJ
tr.who: Asıl adı Memphis Lillian Fairfax Kelly olan Memphis LK, Avustralyalı bir şarkıcı, söz yazarı, plak yapımcısı ve DJ'dir. Oyuncu Kaarin Fairfax ile müzisyen Paul Kelly'nin kızıdır.
facts: Splendour in the Grass ve Pitch Festival gibi festivallerde sahne aldı.
Beyond the Valley ve Way Out West'te de çaldı.

nights.title: WAGE WAR - EMERGENCY BROADCAST TOUR
nights.name: Wage War
nights.extract: Wage War is an American metalcore band formed in Ocala, Florida in 2010 under the name Empires. The band consists of lead vocalist Briton Bond, lead guitarist Seth Blake, rhythm guitarist and clean vocalist Cody Quistad, bassist Chris Gaylord, and drummer Stephen Kluesener.

en.who: Wage War is an American metalcore band formed in Ocala, Florida. The band consists of Briton Bond, Seth Blake, Cody Quistad, Chris Gaylord and Stephen Kluesener.
facts: The band was formed in Ocala, Florida, in 2010 under the name Empires.
Briton Bond is the lead vocalist of the band.

de.who: Wage War ist eine amerikanische Metalcore-Band aus Ocala, Florida. Zu den Mitgliedern gehören Briton Bond, Seth Blake, Cody Quistad, Chris Gaylord und Stephen Kluesener.
facts: Die Band wurde 2010 in Ocala, Florida, unter dem Namen Empires gegründet.
Briton Bond ist der Leadsänger der Band.

tr.who: Wage War, Florida'nın Ocala kentinde kurulmuş bir Amerikan metalcore grubudur. Grupta Briton Bond, Seth Blake, Cody Quistad, Chris Gaylord ve Stephen Kluesener yer alıyor.
facts: Grup 2010'da Ocala, Florida'da Empires adıyla kuruldu.
Briton Bond grubun baş vokalisti.
